title: Google Generation Scholarship
description: The Google Generation Scholarship recognizes outstanding students in computer science and computer engineering.
eligibility_text: Must be enrolled full-time at a four-year university studying computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related technical field. Open to all US and Canadian students regardless of state.

title: Society of Women Engineers Scholarship
description: SWE scholarships support women pursuing ABET-accredited engineering and computer science programs.
eligibility_text: Open to undergraduate students pursuing an engineering or computer science degree at an ABET-accredited program. Available nationwide.

title: Collegiate Inventors Competition
description: Annual competition honoring the most outstanding inventions and innovations by college and university students.
eligibility_text: Open to full-time undergraduate or graduate students at accredited US colleges. Students in all majors are eligible. No state restrictions.

title: Dell Technologies Scholars Program
description: The Dell Scholars Program supports students who have overcome obstacles and demonstrate a strong commitment to their education.
eligibility_text: US citizen or permanent resident. Participating in a college-ready program. Must demonstrate financial need. No state restrictions. Minimum 2.4 GPA required.

title: AFCEA STEM Scholarship
sponsor: Armed Forces Communications and Electronics Association
description: AFCEA scholarships support students pursuing STEM degrees, especially those in cybersecurity, electrical engineering, and computer science.
eligibility_text: Open to US citizens enrolled full-time at accredited colleges and universities. Students majoring in computer science, cybersecurity, electrical engineering, or related fields. Available to students nationwide.
